name: ui-click
prompt: Short dry wooden button click, a quick tap on a wooden crate panel, no reverb

name: fruit-drop
prompt: Soft airy whoosh of a round fruit released and falling a short distance through air

name: fruit-thud
prompt: Dull fleshy thud of a round fruit landing on other fruit inside a wooden crate

name: merge-small
prompt: Light juicy pop of two small berries squishing together into one, bright and wet

name: merge-medium
prompt: Wet juicy squelch of two apples merging together with a short bright magical sparkle

name: merge-large
prompt: Deep juicy splat of two large melons merging together with a warm shimmering glow

name: warn-alert
prompt: Hollow wooden alarm knock struck twice, urgent but soft, orchard crate warning

name: invalid-action
prompt: Short muted error bonk, a soft dull knock on wood signaling a rejected action

name: fanfare-win
prompt: Cheerful short victory jingle with acoustic guitar strums and bells, happy harvest mood

name: fanfare-lose
prompt: Gentle descending disappointed jingle, soft marimba notes falling, game over

name: countdown-tick
prompt: Single crisp dry wooden block tick, short countdown count hit

name: countdown-go
prompt: Bright ascending chime ding signaling go, cheerful start of round
